en.title: NVIDIA GR00T Goes Public: The Generalist Robot AI Platform Now Open to Developers Worldwide
en.summary: NVIDIA opens its GR00T robot foundation model platform to all developers, providing a cloud-based training and deployment pipeline that could democratize generalist robot AI development.

zh.title: NVIDIA GR00T 平台向全球开发者开放：通用型机器人 AI 的民主化时刻
zh.summary: NVIDIA 向所有开发者开放 GR00T 机器人基础模型平台，提供基于云端的训练和部署流程，有望普及通用型机器人 AI 开发。
